title: [Nichibei] Book a Lesson – LA Selection – Archived LA Excluded Even When It Would Otherwise Win on Location and Date
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case: An LA that matches the lesson's location and would win the earliest-start/earliest-created tiebreak must still be excluded from selection if it is archived.
preconditions:
Student A has two Lesson Allocations at the lesson's Location A: LA-A (start = 2026-01-01, would normally win the tiebreak) and LA-B (start = 2026-03-01, the next-best candidate). Both are otherwise eligible (Require_Allocation = TRUE, Type includes Regular, date range covers the lesson date)
LA-A's Archived_At__c is populated (archived via its order group being fully removed)
steps_actions:
1. "Student A books a lesson at Location A"
2. "HQ or CM Staff checks which LA the resulting Student Session is linked to"
steps_result:
1. "Per the code's Archived_At__c = NULL filter, LA-A should not be selected despite having the earliest start date"
2. "LA-B is used, confirming the archived LA was correctly excluded from the candidate set before the tiebreak even ran"
steps_data:
1. "LA-A Archived_At__c = populated"
2. "LA-B is the Lesson_Allocation__c on the new Student Session"

title: [Nichibei] Book a Lesson – LA Archives Between Browse and Confirmation – Booking Blocked (Archive Replaces Legacy 'LA Deleted Mid-Flow')
description: AC-5 - Decision Table - regression-contrast: covers the archive variant of the existing 'LA deleted mid-flow' baseline, since an LA is never hard-deleted mid-flow under the new archive mechanism.
preconditions: Student A has exactly one active Lesson Allocation and has reached the Booking Confirmation screen for a lesson at that LA's location
steps_actions:
1. "Student A opens a bookable lesson and proceeds to the Confirmation screen"
2. "While the Confirmation screen is still open, the Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "Student A taps 'Confirm' to complete the booking"
4. "HQ or CM Staff confirms no Student Session was created for this attempt"
steps_result:
1. "Confirmation screen shown normally, LA still active at this point"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "The booking is rejected - reserveLesson()'s re-run of the LA-selection query finds no eligible LA and throws NO_LESSON_ALLOCATION, surfacing the same 'no active LA' error as the existing baseline"
4. "No orphaned or partial Student Session exists for Student A on this lesson"
steps_data:
1. "Archived_At__c = blank"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "reserveLesson() query excludes the now-archived LA; no Student Session created"
4. "No DML occurred past the LA-selection failure"
